pullRequests.title: feat(jp): take NTSC-J to 99.93% and follow the NTSC decomp
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: feat/jp-finish
pullRequests.body:
JP code goes from 89.57% to 99.93%; three functions are still open. Follows the NTSC decomp to 6513252ca6.
Ratchets rise (address names +173, comments +12, long lines +3): new names keep address-named declarations, as include/names.h says.

pullRequests.title: feat(versions): finish NTSC-J and PAL v1.00 at 100%
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: feat/pal-v1-finish
pullRequests.body:
NTSC-J and PAL v1.00 reach 100%; two PAL v1 functions match only with guessed code tagged FAKEMATCH. NTSC-U reaches 95.1% from carried C.
Stacked on #238; remnants.txt and prebuilt_asm.txt mark functions finished with no C, and merge.tsv and jtbl.tsv are new tool tables.
